description: Source code implementing BIO file operations for OpenSSL, including file opening, reading, writing, seeking, and closing, with platform-specific handling and support for large files.

methods.name: BIO_new_file
methods.description: Creates a new BIO object for file operations, opening the specified file with given mode, platform-specific handling included.

methods.name: BIO_new_fp
methods.description: Creates a new BIO object wrapping an existing FILE pointer.

methods.name: BIO_s_file
methods.description: Returns the BIO_METHOD structure for file BIOs.

methods.name: BIO_get_fp
methods.description: Retrieves the FILE pointer from a BIO object (platform-specific).

methods.name: BIO_set_fp
methods.description: Associates a FILE pointer with a BIO object (platform-specific).

methods.name: BIO_read_filename
methods.description: Opens a file for reading and associates it with a BIO.

methods.name: BIO_write_filename
methods.description: Opens a file for writing and associates it with a BIO.

methods.name: BIO_append_filename
methods.description: Opens a file for appending and associates it with a BIO.

methods.name: BIO_rw_filename
methods.description: Opens a file for reading and writing, and associates it with a BIO.

methods.name: BIO_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the file.
